d:
Rahul Gandhi addressed the INDIA Bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan in New Delhi.
During his speech, he targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Rahul Gandhi said, “Without Gyanesh Kumar, Narendra Modi could not have become Prime Minister.” His remarks came amid the opposition’s campaign against the Election Commission and the ongoing political debate over electoral processes.
Watch the video to know what Rahul Gandhi said at the INDIA Bloc rally.
